message:
Polish the TV after real screenshots; first-run import; progress notes

- Stage: softer lighting so colors stay true, wooden floor, badges get a
  gofun ring, 9+ players shrink into two rows below the question panel,
  winner steps forward and grows on the final screen with a top-3 row
- Host buttons moved to the header so name plates are never covered;
  connection status only shows when something is wrong
- Server strips emoji from names (the TV font can't draw them); bots
  no longer use emoji names
- run_host imports art on the first run so the game can load models
- Stop tracking Blender .blend1 autosave backups (files kept on disk)
- PROGRESS.md: Phase 1 status, what to test next, known issues

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01QqcTkPm2oafgaC56pNSG2L

Phase 1 prototype: rooms, game loop, phone screens, chibi animals, TV stage

- Protocol v2: rooms with 4-letter codes, join/rejoin by token, vote, answer,
  host controls (start, kick, pause, skip, play again), state snapshots
- Server Room state machine: lobby -> vote -> question -> reveal -> scoreboard
  -> game over, server timers, speed-bonus scoring, 16-player cap, auto-pause
  when the TV drops, answers never sent before the reveal
- 50 sample questions (5 categories, unverified) and host/config/game_rules.json
- Phone app: join (code, name, animal), lobby, vote, answer, locked, reveal,
  standings, final result, auto-rejoin after reload; asagi-shu palette
- Placeholder chibi dog, cat, bunny, frog built in Blender by a script
- Godot host: 3D studio stage with podiums and animated toon animals, TV
  screens for every phase, players panel with kick, keyboard controls
- tools/bots.ts fake players, tools/sync_art.mjs, more tests (72 TS, 28 GUT)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01QqcTkPm2oafgaC56pNSG2L

Host: parse bad server JSON quietly, log connection status, track Godot uid files

JSON.parse_string logs an engine error on invalid input, which GUT caught as a
test failure. Use JSON.parse so a bad message is just ignored with a warning.
Verified with Godot 4.7.2: 11/11 GUT tests pass, the host connects to the relay
server, and reconnects when the server starts after the host.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01QqcTkPm2oafgaC56pNSG2L

Phase 0: project scaffold, relay server, phone page, Godot host

- docs/MANIFEST.md (project manifest), CLAUDE.md, PROGRESS, PROTOCOL, ART_SPECS
- Folder structure from manifest section 4
- shared/: protocol v1 (hello / welcome / error) with parsers
- server/: Node + ws relay with /health, logs connects/disconnects
- client/: Vite phone page that shows "Connected to server" and reconnects
- host/: Godot 4.7 project, blank screen with server status, Server autoload
- npm run dev starts server + client + Godot host together
- Tests: Vitest (21 tests) and GUT 9.7.1 vendored in host/addons/gut
